ideas.title: Investigating Non-Profit Organization Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent trend of non-profit organizations being charged with fraud, including the Southern Poverty Law Center.
questions: How widespread is non-profit organization fraud?
What steps can be taken to prevent non-profit organization fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a significant trend of fraud among non-profit organizations, which could lead to changes in regulations and laws governing these organizations.
